reviews.title: Great value
reviews.comment: Great monitor, at first I thought it might be too big for my desk but it works out just perfect. I like the display and refresh rate. Having it only be 1440 really allows my 4060 to hit above 60 fps. It adjusts high easily. Very satisfied.
reviews.author: Justin Moll

reviews.title: Good Monitor
reviews.comment: I did like the monitor, it is as advertised. Very clear and good for gaming, which I use it for the most.
reviews.author: Edwin H.

reviews.title: Great monitor!
reviews.comment: So far have had it for about a month, I got the 32" it's bigger than I thought it would be but it's an amazing monitor for the price. If you're on the fence about it you should definitely give it a try!
reviews.author: Kindle Customer

reviews.title: Good
reviews.comment: Good quality, thin vessel, very responsive and high quality for gaming and watching videos, might need to buy another because it makes my other one look bad now.
reviews.author: Irma M Ayala

reviews.title: Would buy again
reviews.comment: Very nice monitor.  Colors are are good, great clarity, no distortion or dead pixels.  I use for desktop work applications, and some older, non-action type games.
reviews.author: Rob Skdvr
